name: Small Lamp Grass
description: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors.
fullDescription: A wild grass that emits light at night. Used in cooking to enhance other flavors. Just as the subtle fragrance of wild flowers will not distract a focused person, Small Lamp Grass' delicate glow will not attract their attention either, even at night.
sources: Recommendation: Found in the Whispering Woods
